title: Inside Sales Executive
summary: An inside sales executive sells remotely, finding and qualifying business buyers by phone, email and LinkedIn and booking or closing deals without field visits. The role sits early in the sales team of software and services companies, often as a sales development representative who hands qualified meetings to account executives.
dailyDuties: Research target accounts and build lead lists
Make cold calls and send outbound email sequences
Run discovery calls to qualify leads
Book meetings or give short product demos
Log activities and update deal stages in the CRM
Review pipeline and activity numbers with the sales manager

skills.expectation: Prospect into target accounts by phone, email and LinkedIn every day
Qualify inbound and outbound leads on discovery calls before handing over
Keep the pipeline clean and move deals through stages
Log every activity and opportunity in Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho CRM
Run outbound sequences in a sales engagement or prospecting tool
Give short virtual product demos to prospects
Write clear cold emails and handle objections on calls
Close small and mid-size deals against a monthly quota
Forecast the month's pipeline and bookings
Negotiate pricing and discounts within approval limits
Clean lead lists and track activity numbers
